topic: The Barber Pole Effect: Polarized Light in Sugar Solutions

sections.title: Prerequisite: Polarization and Malus's Law
lecture_lines: Polarized light vibrates in a single plane.
A polarizer acts as a gate for light.
Crossed polarizers block all light transmission completely.
animations: Display a linearly polarized light wave [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/wave.svg] #FFFFFF moving in one plane.
Show a vertical polarizer #00FF00 letting only vertical light pass.
Illustrate Malus's Law with intensity curve decreasing as cos^2(theta) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/wave.svg].

sections.title: The Mechanism: Optical Activity of Chiral Molecules
lecture_lines: They physically twist the plane of light.
animations: Visualize a chiral molecule #FF00FF model rotating in 3D space.
Show the plane of polarization vector rotating #FFFF00 clockwise.
Animate the chiral molecule structure and its non-superimposable mirror image.

sections.title: The Barber Pole Effect: Spectral Dependence
lecture_lines: Rotation angle depends on light wavelength.
Different colors rotate at different depths.
This creates a spiraling Barber Pole effect.
White light unblocks colors at different depths.
Colors emerge as a vertical rainbow column.
animations: Display a rainbow spectrum #FF0000-#0000FF entering an optically active medium [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/prism.svg].
Show blue light rotating faster #0000FF than red light #FF0000.
Animate a spiraling Barber Pole visual effect #FFFFFF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/barberpole.svg].
Show intensity changes as specific wavelengths rotate past the analyzer [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/lightbulb.svg].
Display a vertical rainbow column emerging as light passes through.

sections.title: Mathematical Model: Biot's Law
lecture_lines: Increased concentration compresses the Barber Pole stripes.
animations: Write the equation: theta = alpha * c * l #FFFFFF.
Blink each variable to show its role: angle, concentration, path length.
Simulate concentration increasing, causing the rotation angle to steepen as shown by the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/barberpole.svg].

sections.title: Application: The Saccharimeter
lecture_lines: Saccharimeters measure light rotation for purity.
They detect sugar concentration in industrial syrup.
